links.outcome: Reading grade level of ChatGPT glaucoma responses versus AAO website text
links.effect: ChatGPT responses required grade 12.5 ± 1.6 reading comprehension versus 9.4 ± 3.5 for AAO website text (0.0384).
links.quote: ChatGPT's responses required reading comprehension of a higher grade level (average = grade 12.5 ± 1.6) than that of the text on the AAO's website (average = 9.4 grade ± 3.5), (0.0384).

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient materials relative to intended user level
links.effect: ChatGPT average grade 12.5 ± 1.6 vs AAO 9.4 ± 3.5; authors say answers could be too difficult for a patient to read.
links.quote: However, ChatGPT has a tendency toward repetitive answers and, due to their elevated readability scores, these could be too difficult for a patient to read.

screen.reason: Evaluates readability and terminology of ChatGPT responses to patient glaucoma questions compared to American Academy of Ophthalmology web content.
